intro: A trainer in hopelessly out-of-place clothing studies a map that is definitely upside down.
speaker: Faraway Traveler
introDialogue: Oh! A local! Wonderful. I'm from... well, from several very far aways, actually.$My whole team came with me — you won't find shapes like these around here, I promise you that.$Care to see how the other regions do it? Winner gets... hmm. Let's say, if YOU win, I share a little piece of home.
title: The Faraway Traveler
description: The traveler battles with regional forms — Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian. Defeat them and choose your prize: one of three random base-stage regional Pokémon now, or a promise — they'll return later to convert one of YOUR Pokémon into its regional counterpart.

1.label: Battle for a Companion
1.tooltip:
(+) Win: choose one of three random base-stage regional Pokémon
(-) A trainer battle
1.selected: A new friend it is! Alright, my far-flung dears — show them where we're from!

2.label: Battle for a Favor
2.tooltip:
(+) Win: the traveler will return later to convert one of your Pokémon into a regional form
(-) A trainer battle, and patience
2.selected: A promise, then! I never break those — I've carried some across three regions. Now: defend yourself!

3.label: Wave Them Off
3.selected: No time for tourism? Shame. Travel broadens the type chart, you know.

outro: The traveler re-folds their map incorrectly and strides off in what is probably the wrong direction.
